title: The derived graded coefficient-filtration triangle
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative ring in the independent coefficient universe, J an ideal, and N an object of the actual constant-A pro-etale derived category [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. For n >= 0 put B=A/J^(n+2), C=A/J^(n+1), and I=ker(B -> C), regarded as a B-module. Let I[0] be its exact constant module realization in degree zero [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor]. Let L_n=(N tensor_A^L B) tensor_B^L I[0], using the existing K-flat derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated]. There exist morphisms making L_n -> N tensor_A^L B -> Res_B^C(N tensor_A^L C) -> L_n[1] a distinguished triangle. No constructibility, Noetherianity or boundedness assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 09BR, lemma-compare-truncations-constructible, first displayed triangle; exact constant realization and K-flat balancing.

proof.text: For B=A/J^(n+2), C=A/J^(n+1), let p:B -> C be the actual quotient factor. Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective proves surjectivity. Construct the short complex ker(p) -> B -> Res_p(C), with the ideal subtype and the linear quotient map. ModuleCat mono/epi criteria and elementwise exactness prove it short exact. Apply the exact commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor and Mathlib ShortComplex.ShortExact.singleTriangle_distinguished.

Identify the constant realization of the regular C-module restricted to B with the restriction of the regular constant-C ring sheaf. Its comparison is induced by the constant-ring sheafification unit: naturality makes it B-linear. The seed is locally injective and locally surjective, as is the module-sheafification unit. Cancellation of these local properties and reflection of isomorphisms by the underlying additive-sheaf functor prove the comparison invertible. For p=id this also identifies the constant regular B-module with the tensor unit.

For any derived object M, choose a flat-term K-flat resolution of a representative. Convert termwise tensor-flatness to IsFlatOnSite using siteSheafTensorRightIso. The published coherent kFlat_fixed_tensor_triangulated theorem gives triangulatedness for the resolving object. Its bifunctor shift compatibility makes the isomorphism from that object to M shift-compatible, so Functor.isTriangulated_of_iso gives exactness of tensoring by M. Tensor the coefficient triangle by M=N tensor_A^L B.

Use ringed_kFlat_single_tensor_comparison on a K-flat representative to compute tensoring M with a module in degree zero. For the regular B-module, the ordinary right unitor identifies the result with M. For the restricted regular C-module, the ordinary extensionTensorIso (the natural form of exists_extensionTensorComparison, preceded by braiding) identifies the termwise tensor with restricted scalar extension. The exact restriction comparison resFactors and the invertible K-flat extendComparison identify its localization with dres(p)(extend(p)(M)). The constant-module isomorphisms in step 2 give the endpoints actually used in the coefficient triangle.

The canonical adicFiniteRho identifies extend(p)(N tensor_A^L B) with N tensor_A^L C. The first endpoint is definitionally adicFiniteGradedLayer. Compose the endpoint isomorphisms, conjugate the three triangle arrows, and apply Triangle.isoMk and isomorphic_distinguished. This proves the unchanged existential triangle statement. No flatness, boundedness, completeness or constructibility hypothesis is introduced; zero ideals, unit ideals, zero rings and empty schemes use the same constructions.

theorem adicFiniteGradedLayer_triangle (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (N : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (f : adicFiniteGradedLayer.{u, v} X J N n ⟶
        adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N (n + 1))
      (g : adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N (n + 1) ⟶
        adicFiniteRestrictedReduction.{u, v} X J N n)
      (δ : adicFiniteRestrictedReduction.{u, v} X J N n ⟶
        (adicFiniteGradedLayer.{u, v} X J N n)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk f g δ ∈ distTriang _
